title: Pop-Up Book Animation — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The book opens into a connected system
scenes.purpose: Page mechanics drive the reveal: opening the book raises the IDEA V-fold and the LINK/NODE cards, so one idea becomes a connected system.
visuals: Two thin paper page boards #F1E5CE with seeded grain and printed #342B25 dashed wiring
IDEA bulb V-fold with glued tabs; two LINK and two NODE hinged cards
Soft key + fill light, PCF soft contact shadows, ACES tone map
Static heading 'An idea becomes a connected system' (#F1E5CE) and kicker 'FOLD · LIFT · LINK' (#C3BDAD)

beats.development: Book nearly closed at θ = 20°; rust cover lies over the left page, camera high and left.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: θ opens (power2.inOut); the right page swings with a slight procedural curl, the V-fold halves start rising from their tabs, camera dollies to centre.
The V-fold crease climbs to vertical via the tabulated closed-loop hinge solution; LINK then NODE cards lift on their hinges; contact shadows grow; θ reaches 180° and the curl flattens.
Settled hold: full spread legible, camera stopped by 2.5 s.

findings: Motion completes by 2.5 s, inside the 2.7 s settle requirement.
Panel labels live in panel textures and appear only with their panels.
justifiedHolds: 2.45–3.0 s reading hold on the finished pop-up spread.

notes: Silent preview: no music, voice or effects.
No preview_recipes in STYLE.json; demonstrates the primary V-fold opening recipe.
